description_en: Queries the history of batch requests for member quotas submitted using a quota template
description_zh: 查询配额模板批量申请成员配额的申请历史
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications-for-template --product-code ecs-spec --quota-action-code ecs.g5.2xlarge --batch-quota-application-id d314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000 --quota-category CommonQuota --next-token 4 --max-results 30 --apply-start-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --apply-end-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service, see the `ProductCode` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the batch quota application
parameters.name: batch_quota_application_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the quota. Valid values:

CommonQuota: general quota.

FlowControl: API rate limit.

WhiteListLabel: privilege
parameters.help_zh:
配额种类。取值：
CommonQuota：通用配额。
FlowControl：API速率配额。
WhiteListLabel：权益配额
parameters.name: quota_category

parameters.help_en:
The token that marks the start of the data to read.

If you do not set this parameter, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记开始读取数据的位置。

不设置该参数，表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is in UTC.

The interval between `ApplyStartTime` and `ApplyEndTime` must be 7 days or less. If you do not set these two parameters, quota applications submitted within the last 7 days are queried
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请开始的UTC时间。

`ApplyStartTime`和`ApplyEndTime`之间的时间间隔必须小于等于7天。如果未设置这两个参数，则配额申请时间为最近7天
parameters.name: apply_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is in UTC.

The interval between `ApplyStartTime` and `ApplyEndTime` must be 7 days or less. If you do not set these two parameters, quota applications submitted within the last 7 days are queried
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请结束的UTC时间。

`ApplyStartTime`和`ApplyEndTime`之间的时间间隔必须小于等于7天。如果未设置这两个参数，则配额申请时间为最近7天
parameters.name: apply_end_time

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned for the query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en: The token that marks the start of the data to read
NextToken.description_zh: 用来标记开始读取数据的位置
